_comment: web-terminal-kiro's BUNDLED TOOLS: the tools this image ships because
its seeded manifest names them and no registry carries them.
These are not a layer over the tool catalog. The catalog is a
REFERENCE -- every tool the mise and aqua registries can express,
translated, with no opinion about which ones matter -- and this file
is the small bundle this app adds to it. Deliberately small: the app
drives kiro-cli's TUI verbatim and consumes toolbelt HEADLESS, so
there is no Add-tool modal, no recommended set and no UI copy to own.
What is left is the four language servers the seed ships, each
installable from a package registry toolbelt already speaks.
Everything else required-tools.txt names comes from the reference:
rust-analyzer and gh (through the github-cli entry's alias) are aqua
packages, node and go are mise core: backends the compiler translates,
uv is its own aqua entry, and the 14 linters in the borgcube migration
Nothing here is marked essential. That flag means a product feature
stops working without the tool, and a language server is a convenience
in a terminal: the seed ships all four DISABLED, so a user removing
one is removing something they turned on themselves.
